warnings: Bars are printed 'ø' throughout — type RB per section 0.6; no steel grade is printed on this sheet.

C1 is detailed twice by level (section 8, same mark repeated with a level field): 0.25x0.25 'จากฐานราก ถึง คานคอดิน' with 2" cover, 0.20x0.20 'จากคานคอดิน ถึง หลังคา' with 1" cover. Covers kept in mm (51 / 25) with the inch print beside them.
C2 0.20x0.20 'จากฐานราก ถึง คานคอดิน' is the stub on footing F2 (row C) — this detail is why the footing plan records C2, not the printed C1, at row C.
Footing mats are printed as a spacing (ø9มม @0.10ม#), not a bar count — count omitted rather than computed (section 6b).

Pile length conflict: both footing sections call the pile '○ 0.15x5.00ม.' while ข้อกำหนดเสาเข็ม on the same sheet says '○ 0.15x6.00ม' (and allows a 0.12x0.12x6.00 substitute). Took 5.00 (two callouts attached to the members vs one note); the 6.00 reading is plausible, so the pile entry's confidence is lowered and both prints are kept.
Embedment: 1.20 from ระดับดินเดิม to the footing underside, footing 0.20, lean 0.05, sand 0.10 — same on F1 and F2.
